Initialize a new drt project in the current directory.

## Usage

```bash
drt init [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--from-dbt` | `TEXT` |  | Path to dbt manifest.json — generate sync YAMLs from dbt models. |
| `--template` | `TEXT` |  | Scaffold from a curated template. Use 'list' to see available templates. |
